summary: Make transient member storage-reconciliation failures diagnosable without leaking raw errors (BUG-0155). API impact: existing contract; existing check error text reports a bounded stage and outcome.

guide.reason: Explain current reconciliation failures, automatic retry and safe investigation without treating healthy mounts or old task history as proof of current control-plane health.

api.reason: API impact: existing contract. Core's existing pool-storage-reconciliation check.error carries safe diagnostic text through existing inventory reports and Controller relay. No new field, endpoint, authorization or durable Controller state; error is already a free-form string in machine-readable contracts.

roadmap.reason: Observability correction only; the underlying intermittent failure and production gate remain open.

state.reason: Diagnostic stage belongs to the existing in-memory Core observation; pool registrations remain in the existing master record, unchanged.

verification.method: Native member health reported fresh failure and recovery while registered backends remained accessible. Old generic errors cannot reconstruct the original cause. Full Go race tests and independent review passed. Behavioral tests exercise classification/redaction and recovery; source-bound checks bind local/orphan deadline and cancellation branches to tags without claiming native execution of those branches. After the audited three-Core deployment, actual fresh member reports exposed repository-stage deadline failures and later healthy reconciliation. Independent review accepted the rollout and diagnostic observation. The underlying recurring timeout, other native failure branches and production acceptance remain open; hosted CI is unrun.
